name: Lakeside Manor
source:
"Lakeside Manor - caring for our otherwordly friends."

Who watches over extraterrestrials and monsters when they are aging? In this short demo, players take the role of a junior care assistant on their first shift, in a home for the creatures not of our world. 

Spend time with the mysterious "Pearl," lend a friendly ear and see what you can learn about her world.

Just remember: The second floor is off-limits...

[From [url=https://syncing-ships.itch.io/lakeside-manor-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“湖畔庄园——照顾我们平凡的朋友。”

谁在照顾衰老的外星人和怪物？在这个简短的演示中，玩家在第一个轮班中扮演初级护理助理的角色，在一个不属于我们世界的生物的家中。

花时间与神秘的“珍珠”相处，友善地倾听，看看你能了解她的世界。

请记住：二楼是禁区……

[来自[url=https://syncing-ships.itch.io/lakeside-manor-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
